title: Your KAABIL *Parchi*
lede: A printed skill card you can carry — no smartphone needed. Show it at any KAABIL Station or to an employer.
pdfHint: To save as PDF, choose “Save as PDF” in the print window.
blockedHint: If printing doesn't open, ask the Station helper, or take a photo of this slip.
